stages: original Tor volume snapshotted read-only through an age encryption pipe; original Tor restarted
both onion names regenerated from restored keys with Tor networking disabled; ownership and permissions match
restored proxy started with recovered configuration; missing/wrong token refused and recovered token accepted
separate archives retained outside the repository under the owner SSH public recipient; no owner private key was accessed
limits: The owner-recipient archives are retained locally, not off-device. Decryption with the owner SSH private key was not attempted; the agent never accessed that key.
The isolated restore used a disposable age recipient. Its temporary private identity, ciphertext archives and restored plaintext files were deleted afterward.
Restored Tor ran with DisableNetwork=1 and Docker network none; no descriptor publication or remote onion reachability was tested.
The recovered proxy used loopback for identity/token checks and its configured public execution upstream for eth_chainId; no new anonymous browser proof was established.
Payment settlement keys, payment journals and funded delegation ledgers are outside this backup/restore drill.
